Name: Kenneth's English Country Garden
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's English Country Garden - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 6 new crops: Chamomile, Echinacea, Lavender, Mint, Rosemary and Sage.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]All crops are seasonal and regrowable.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]It also adds 6 teas and Fish and Chips.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Seeds are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Teas are sold at Kenneth's Drink Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Fish and Chips is sold at Kenneth's Restaurant.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]All items can also be cooked with cooking recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod is balanced for vanilla gameplay and designed to fit naturally into the game.[/b][/size]
